mentions.name: Avotoast
mentions.description: AI assistant for property research in Sydney, Australia. It began as an MCP providing accurate property data and evolved into a full web app plus AI assistant. API endpoints are powered by in-process DuckDB querying parquet files stored on disk.
mentions.problem: The author was frustrated with outdated and inaccurate data Claude used when doing property research.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm currently working on https://avotoast.ai, an AI assistant for doing property research for Sydney, Australia.
